1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora de hasta 5 m de altura, de hojas delgadas, ovales y acorazonadas en la base, inflorescencia en racimos numerosos con muchas flores rosas o rojas; es ornamental. Polygonaceae; Antigonon leptopus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant reaching a height of up to 5 m, with slender, oval leaves that are heart-shaped at the base, inflorescence in numerous racemes with many pink or red flowers; it is ornamental. Polygonaceae; Antigonon leptopus.
